limitations: No noise-only windows: candidate precision is conditional on event windows
No matched retraining; released checkpoints have different training sources
STEAD is a training source for original EQTransformer; full-cohort results include original train/dev splits
Original test split is record-level; event/station overlap has not been audited
P is fixed at the 10 s packet boundary; this is not arbitrary-onset continuous replay
Window fill delay depends on cold start and native-window policy, not only neural inference speed
Source magnitude and P labels are used only to define and score the cohort
